_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public court, inquiry, UNODC and journalistic records. Convictions are distinct from alleged organizational roles. Public figures only; source-supported operational country associations (arrest and custody countries omitted from the map); no operational routes, precise private/live locations, or unlicensed photos.
